storage_deviation: stored under data/historical instead of the approved data/seasons path because that path is the gitignored runtime season store

results_odds.name: football-data.co.uk SP1 archive
results_odds.note: single authoritative file per season: 380 completed matches of a 20-team double round-robin with final scores and closing 1X2 odds; bookmaker preference Pinnacle -> Bet365 -> Max -> Avg; odds_known_at recorded as the kickoff event_date (closing line knowable at kickoff). Early seasons pre-date Pinnacle/Bet365 coverage, so odds are simply absent there (coverage reported per season, never fabricated); several early archive files carry ragged trailing columns, normalized by the source adapter without dropping a match.

elo.name: xgabora/Club-Football-Match-Data EloRatings.csv
elo.deviation: live api.clubelo.com unreachable from this environment; using MIT-licensed ClubElo snapshot mirror strictly before each season's first match (pre-match, no leakage)

team_keys.canonical: data/team_aliases.json keys; long-form aliases used by the 2026/27 production fixtures preferred where present
team_keys.extras: teams absent from 2026/27 (e.g. Almeria, Cadiz, Eibar, Girona, Granada, Huesca, Las Palmas, Leganes, Mallorca, Valladolid, plus the 2000/01-2018/19 historical clubs Albacete, Cordoba, Gimnastic, Hercules, La Coruna, Murcia, Numancia, Oviedo, Recreativo, Santander, Sp Gijon, Tenerife, Xerez, Zaragoza) get stable new keys via backfill/team_map.py
